raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in the conclusion that Maximum Ride came out earlier than It’s Our Life!. The Planner correctly identified the release dates for both films: It’s Our Life! was released on December 7, 2005, and Maximum Ride was released on August 30, 2016 (Digital HD) and September 30, 2016 (limited theatrical). However, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Maximum Ride predates It’s Our Life!, despite the earlier release date of It’s Our Life! in 2005.
